source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the importance of online research (PDF 195).

blocks.text: Online research wasee maloomat tak jaldi aur aasan rasai deti hai. Students homework, mahireen taaza rehne aur har koi soch samajh kar faisle karne ke liye ise istemal karta hai. Magar online har cheez durust nahi; kuch websites ghalat ya gumrah kun tafseel deti hain, is liye motabar maakhaz dhoondna aana chahiye.

blocks.prompt: Online maakhaz ke motabar hone ki parakh kyun zaroori hai (short question 2)?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke online koi bhi shaya kar sakta hai aur kuch sites ghalat ya gumrah kun maloomat phailati hain; is ka istemal ghalat jawab, kharab faisle aur ghalat maloomat phailane ka sabab ban sakta hai.

items: Online research tez aur wasee hai, magar aitbaar jaanchna zaroori hai.
